Middleware Order Fix

  • Unauthenticated requests skip TenantContextMiddleware cleanly (preserving 401)
  • Cold-cache warm prevents false 403 after AdminPermissionCache invalidation
  • Bidirectional MembershipMode works whether Home=false/Target=true or Home=true/Target=false

Commit-Before-Invalidate

  • DB transaction commits before FeatureCache & AdminPermissionCache clear
  • PrincipalResponseCacheHelper bumps version stamps so 30s cache never serves stale perms
  • Regular RolePermission rows survive temporary feature disables intact
